translation: Ba a da kwafin a cikin wannan na'ura mai ba da hanya tsakanin hanyoyin sadarwa.

raw_translation: Mai kula da sakamako na cikin gida ga tsarin farawa kai tsaye, fitarwa biyu na ZXQPH0000QXZ/ZXQPH0001QXZ. Ka shigar da sassa waɗanda suka faɗi kan kwandon wasa. Yaƙi zai mai da sakamakon daga kafin wannan ziyara. An ƙididdige shawarwarin fitarwa daga dokokin kwandon wasa guda. Za'a iya bambanta tsakanin sifofin gasar; babu sakamako ko sunaye da ke fita daga wannan mai bincike.
source: Local scorekeeper for the common 301/501 straight-start, double-out format. Enter the segments that landed on the board. A bust restores the score from before that visit. Checkout suggestions are calculated from the same board rules. League formats can differ; no scores or names leave this browser.
translation: Mai kula da sakamako na cikin gida ga tsarin farawa kai tsaye, fitarwa biyu na 301/501. Ka shigar da sassa waɗanda suka faɗi kan kwandon wasa. Yaƙi zai mai da sakamakon daga kafin wannan ziyara. An ƙididdige shawarwarin fitarwa daga dokokin kwandon wasa guda. Za'a iya bambanta tsakanin sifofin gasar; babu sakamako ko sunaye da ke fita daga wannan mai bincike.
